_comment: Versioned policy registry. Every (policy, JDM) pair is pinned by sha256 of its LF-normalised bytes. Editing a pinned file without registering a new version makes load_policy() fail closed. ALL versions here are SYNTHETIC prototype policies, not lender policy.

synthetic-v1.threshold_source: Prototype assumption recorded in personal_loan_synthetic_v1.json (P0). NOT a VaaniLabs or lender policy.

synthetic-v2.threshold_source: Catalogue v2 compiled to JDM (decision_engine/catalogue_v2/compile.py); ADR-0011 values OWNER_APPROVED for prototype_synthetic only. NOT a lender policy.
synthetic-v2.selected_by: SARAL_POLICY_VERSION=synthetic-v2 (bureau-backed runs); v1 stays active and is the fallback
